    if (!provider) throw new Error('Provider non disponibile');
    try {
      const currentChain = await provider.request({ method: 'eth_chainId' });
      if (currentChain.toLowerCase() === AVAX_CHAIN_ID.toLowerCase()) return;
    } catch (e) { console.warn('[Switch] Check chainId fail', e); }

    try { await provider.request({ method: 'wallet_switchEthereumChain', params: [{ chainId: AVAX_CHAIN_ID }] }); } 
    catch(e) {
      const code = e.code; const msg = String(e.message || '').toLowerCase();
      if (code === 4902 || code === -32603 || code === -32000 || msg.includes('unrecognized') || msg.includes('chain')) {
        try { await provider.request({ method: 'wallet_addEthereumChain', params: [AVAX_CHAIN_PARAMS] }); }

  };

  // --- PAYMENT FUNCTIONS ---
  window.sendAvaxPayment = async function(amountAvax) {
    const wallet = window._walletAddress; const treasury = window._TREASURY;

    const weiHex = '0x' + (BigInt(Math.round(amountAvax * 1e6)) * BigInt(1e12)).toString(16);

    if (!prov) throw new Error('Provider non trovato.');
    await window.switchToAvalanche(prov);

    try {

         gasLimit = '0x' + Math.floor(estNum * 1.3).toString(16); 
      } catch(e) { console.warn("Gas estimation failed, using safe default"); }

      const txHash = await prov.request({ method: 'eth_sendTransaction', params: [{ from: wallet, to: treasury, value: weiHex, gas: gasLimit }] });
      console.log('✅ AVAX tx sent:', txHash); return txHash;

      const m = String(e.message || '').toLowerCase();

        metadata: { name: 'Arena Coins', description:'⚔️ Tap to earn on AVAX', url: window.location.origin, icons: ['https://arena.social/icons/logo.svg'] },
        features: { analytics: false, email: false, socials: false },
      });
      window._modal = _modal;
      function onModalStateChange() { try { const acc = _modal.getAccount ? _modal.getAccount() : null; if (acc && acc.isConnected && acc.address && acc.address !== window._walletAddress) { window._setWallet(acc.address); window._onWalletConnected && window._onWalletConnected(acc.address); } } catch {} }
      try { _modal.subscribeState && _modal.subscribeState(onModalStateChange); } catch {}
      setInterval(onModalStateChange, 1500);
    } catch(e) { console.warn('[AppKit] init failed:', e.message); }
  }
  function initArenaSdk() {
    try { const SDK = window.ArenaAppStoreSdk || window.ArenaSDK || window.Arena; if (!SDK) return; _arenaSdk = new SDK({ projectId: PROJECT_ID, metadata: { name: 'Arena Coins', description: '⚔️', url: window.location.href, icons: ['https://arena.social/icons/logo.svg'] } }); if (_arenaSdk.on) { _arenaSdk.on('walletChanged', function(data) { const address = data && (data.address || data); if (address && typeof address === 'string' && address !== window._walletAddress) { window._setWallet(address); window._onWalletConnected && window._onWalletConnected(address); } }); } window._arenaSdk = _arenaSdk; } catch(e) {}
  }
  function checkAutoConnect() {

  <div class="cs-msg" id="connectMsg"></div>
</div>

<div id="app">
  <div class="top-bar">
    <div class="arena-logo">ARENA</div>
    <div class="top-right">
      <div class="badge" id="walletBadge" onclick="onWalletBadgeClick()">🔗 Connect</div>

    </div>
  </div>

  </div>
  <div class="combo-wrap"><div class="combo-badge" id="comboBadge">COMBO x1</div></div>
  <div class="energy-section">
    <div class="energy-header"><span>⚡ Energy</span><span class="energy-val" id="energyVal">100/100</span></div>
    <div class="energy-track"><div class="energy-fill" id="energyFill" style="width:100%"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="regen-info" id="regenInfo"></div>
  <div class="arena-ring">
    <div class="ring-outer"></div><div class="ring-mid"></div><div class="ring-glow"></div>
    <button class="tap-btn" id="tapBtn" ontouchstart="handleTap(event)" onmousedown="handleTap(event)">

      <div class="btn-power" id="powerLabel">POWER x1</div>
    </button>
  </div>
  <div class="tap-hint">TAP TO EARN COINS</div>

    <button class="action-btn" onclick="openLeaderboard()">🏆 Ranks</button>

const BACKEND_URL = window.location.hostname.includes('render.com')
  ? ''  // same origin when served from Render
  : 'https://arenatap-14nh.onrender.com';
const MAX_ENERGY = 100, ENERGY_REGEN_MIN = 5;
const SYNC_MS = 8000;
// #9 FIX: Combo now requires progressively faster taps — harder to reach max
const COMBO_WINDOW_START = 700;   // ms — window for combo x1→x2
const COMBO_WINDOW_MIN = 350;     // ms — window narrows as combo grows (hardest)
const MAX_COMBO = 10;
const PRIZE_DIST = [0.40, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.05, 0.03, 0.03, 0.04];

const S = {
  wallet:null, coins:0, tapPower:1, energy:MAX_ENERGY,
  streak:0, seasonCoins:0, sprintCoins:0, prizePool:0, rank:null,
  pendingTaps:0, syncing:false,
  combo:1, comboTimer:null, lastTapTime:0,
  serverTs:0,  // #2 FIX: track last server sync timestamp
  pendingTapTimes:[],  // timestamps of pending taps (ms) for server combo calc
  batchStartTime:0,    // when current tap batch started
  tapsDuringSync:0,    // FIX: track taps made while flushTaps is in-flight
};
let syncTimer=null, regenTimer=null;

// #7 + #12 FIX: localStorage persistence for offline support & beforeunload safety
const LS_KEY_PENDING = 'arena_pending_taps';
function savePending() {
  if (S.pendingTaps > 0) {
    localStorage.setItem(LS_KEY_PENDING, JSON.stringify({ t: S.pendingTaps, w: S.wallet, ts: Date.now() }));
  } else {
    localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY_PENDING);
  }
}
function loadPending() {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_KEY_PENDING);
    if (!raw) return;
    const d = JSON.parse(raw);
    // Only recover if same wallet and less than 5 minutes old
    if (d.w && d.w.toLowerCase() === (S.wallet || '').toLowerCase() && Date.now() - d.ts < 300000) {
      S.pendingTaps += d.t;
      console.log(`[Offline] Recovered ${d.t} pending taps from localStorage`);
    }
    localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY_PENDING);
  } catch {}
}

async function api(path, body) {
  const r = await fetch(BACKEND_URL + path, body
    ? { method:'POST', headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body:JSON.stringify(body) }
    : { method:'GET' });
  return r.json();
}

async function signLogin(address) {
  const provider = window.getProvider();
  if (!provider) throw new Error('No provider');
  
  const message = `Sign this message to verify ownership of ${address}.\n\nNonce: ${Date.now()}`;
  try {
    const signature = await provider.request({
      method: 'personal_sign',
      params: [message, address]
    });
    
    const r = await api('/api/auth/verify', {
      wallet_address: address,
      signature: signature,
      message: message
    });
    
    return r.ok && r.verified;
  } catch(e) {
    console.error("Sign error", e);
    return false;
  }
}

    S.sprintCoins = u.sprint_coins|| 0;
    // #12 FIX: Recover any pending taps from previous session (offline/crash)
    loadPending();

    window._currentSession = address;
    
    if (res.is_new && ref && ref !== address) {
      setTimeout(() => showToast('👥 Referral bonus applied! Your recruiter got +1,000 coins', 'success'), 2000);

    loadPrizePool(); loadRank();
    startRegenLoop(); startSyncLoop();
    renderGame(); showApp();
    
    // Show Username Modal ONLY if new or default name
    if (res.is_new || (u.username === 'Gladiator' || u.username === 'Anon' || !u.username)) {

  }

function calcEnergy(saved, lastISO) {
  if (!lastISO) return saved ?? MAX_ENERGY;
  return Math.min((saved||0) + Math.floor((Date.now()-new Date(lastISO).getTime())/60000/ENERGY_REGEN_MIN), MAX_ENERGY);
}
function startRegenLoop() {
  clearInterval(regenTimer);
  regenTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if (S.energy < MAX_ENERGY) { S.energy = Math.min(S.energy+1, MAX_ENERGY); updateEnergyUI(); }
    const el = document.getElementById('regenInfo');
    if (el) el.innerHTML = S.energy >= MAX_ENERGY ? '<span>⚡ Energy full!</span>' : `Regen +1 / ${ENERGY_REGEN_MIN} min`;
  }, ENERGY_REGEN_MIN * 60000);
}

function startSyncLoop() {
  clearInterval(syncTimer);
  syncTimer = setInterval(flushTaps, SYNC_MS);
  // FIX: Only save pending taps to localStorage on page close.
  // Previously sendBeacon + localStorage caused DOUBLE-COUNTING on reload.
  window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    if (S.wallet && S.pendingTaps > 0) {
      savePending();
    }
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) flushTaps(); });
}

async function flushTaps() {
  if (!S.wallet || S.syncing || !S.pendingTaps) return;
  S.syncing = true;
  S.tapsDuringSync = 0;  // Reset counter for taps made during this sync
  const t = S.pendingTaps; S.pendingTaps = 0;
  // Build tap_offsets: relative ms from first tap in this batch
  const offsets = S.pendingTapTimes.map(ts => ts - S.batchStartTime);
  S.pendingTapTimes = []; S.batchStartTime = 0;
  localStorage.removeItem(LS_KEY_PENDING);
  try {
    // #1 FIX: Send taps + offsets — server calculates combo from timestamps
    const r = await api('/api/tap', { wallet_address: S.wallet, taps: t, tap_offsets: offsets, last_sync_ts: S.serverTs });
    if (r.ok) {
      // CRITICAL FIX: Never let the displayed score go BACKWARDS.
      // The client does optimistic coin updates during tapping (S.coins += earned).
      // The server calculates independently and may differ slightly.
      // Using Math.max ensures the user NEVER sees their score decrease.
      // The server is still the source of truth for what gets SAVED to DB.
      S.coins = Math.max(S.coins, r.coins);
      // FIX: Subtract taps made during sync from server energy to avoid jump
      S.energy = Math.max(0, r.energy - S.tapsDuringSync);
      S.tapPower = r.tap_power || S.tapPower;
      S.seasonCoins = r.season_coins || S.seasonCoins;
      S.sprintCoins = r.sprint_coins || 0;
      S.serverTs = r.server_ts || Date.now() / 1000;

      updateCoinsUI();
      updateEnergyUI();
      document.getElementById('statSeason').textContent = fmt(S.seasonCoins);
      document.getElementById('powerLabel').textContent = `POWER x${S.tapPower}`;

      loadRank();
    }
    else {
      // Re-queue failed taps (include taps made during sync)
      S.pendingTaps += t + S.tapsDuringSync;
      savePending();
    }
  } catch {
    // #12 FIX: On network failure, keep taps and persist to localStorage
    S.pendingTaps += t + S.tapsDuringSync;
    savePending();
  }
  finally { S.syncing = false; S.tapsDuringSync = 0; }
}

function handleTap(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (!S.wallet) { showToast('Connect wallet to play!','warn'); return; }
  if (S.energy <= 0) {
    const b=document.getElementById('tapBtn'); b.classList.add('no-energy'); setTimeout(()=>b.classList.remove('no-energy'),350);
    showToast('⚡ No energy! Wait or refill.','warn'); return;
  }
  const now=Date.now();

  // FIX: If we're starting a new batch (after a flush), reset combo to 1
  // so client combo matches server's calc_combo_from_offsets (which always starts at 1)
  if (S.pendingTapTimes.length === 0) {
    S.batchStartTime = now;
    S.combo = 1;
    S.lastTapTime = 0;
  }

  // #9 FIX: Progressive combo — window narrows as combo grows
  // x2 needs <700ms, x3 <630ms, ... x10 <350ms
  const comboWindow = S.combo <= 1
    ? COMBO_WINDOW_START
    : Math.max(COMBO_WINDOW_MIN, COMBO_WINDOW_START - (S.combo - 1) * ((COMBO_WINDOW_START - COMBO_WINDOW_MIN) / (MAX_COMBO - 1)));

  if (now - S.lastTapTime > comboWindow) {
    S.combo = 1; // combo broken — too slow
  } else {
    S.combo = Math.min(S.combo + 1, MAX_COMBO);
  }
  S.lastTapTime = now;
  clearTimeout(S.comboTimer);
  // Combo resets if no tap within 1.5x the current window
  S.comboTimer = setTimeout(() => { S.combo=1; document.getElementById('comboBadge').classList.remove('show'); }, comboWindow * 1.5);

  // #1 FIX: Coins are cosmetic-only client side; server does real calc
  const earned = S.tapPower * S.combo;
  S.coins += earned; // optimistic display
  // Record tap timestamp for server combo calculation (reuse 'now' from line above)
  S.pendingTapTimes.push(now);
  S.pendingTaps += 1;
  S.energy = Math.max(0, S.energy - 1);
  // FIX: Track taps made while flushTaps is in-flight
  if (S.syncing) S.tapsDuringSync += 1;
  updateCoinsUI(); updateEnergyUI();

  const t = e.touches?.[0] || e.changedTouches?.[0] || e;
  spawnTapFloat(t.clientX, t.clientY, earned);
  if (S.combo >= 5) spawnParticles(t.clientX, t.clientY, S.combo * 3);
  if (S.combo > 1) {
    const b = document.getElementById('comboBadge');
    b.textContent = `COMBO x${S.combo}${S.combo >= MAX_COMBO ? ' 🔥' : ''}`;
    b.classList.add('show');
  }
  else document.getElementById('comboBadge').classList.remove('show');
  const el = document.getElementById('coinsDisplay'); el.classList.remove('bump'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('bump'); setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('bump'), 120);

  // #7 FIX: Auto-save pending taps periodically (every 20 taps as safety net)
  if (S.pendingTaps % 20 === 0) savePending();
}
window.handleTap = handleTap;

var SEGMENTS = buildSegments();

// ============================================================
// DRAW WHEEL — EVERYTHING on canvas, zero CSS overlays
// ============================================================
function drawWheel() {
    if (!rwCtx) setupRouletteCanvas();
    var S = 300;
    var cx = S / 2;
    var cy = S / 2;

    // Layout: outer decorative ring(10px) + dark border(6px) + segments + inner
    var outerRingW = 10;
    var darkBorderW = 6;
    var outerR = cx - 1;                        // 149
    var darkRingR = outerR - outerRingW / 2;    // center of dark ring = 144
    var segR = darkRingR - darkBorderW / 2;     // 141 — segments radius

    rwCtx.clearRect(0, 0, S, S);

    // 0) Outer decorative ring (gold/orange alternating segments)
    var numDots = NUM_SEGMENTS * 2;
    for (var d = 0; d < numDots; d++) {
        var a1 = (d / numDots) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
        var a2 = ((d + 1) / numDots) * 2 * Math.PI - Math.PI / 2;
        rwCtx.beginPath();
        rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, darkRingR + darkBorderW / 2 + outerRingW / 2, a1, a2);
        rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, darkRingR + darkBorderW / 2 - outerRingW / 2, a2, a1, true);
        rwCtx.closePath();
        rwCtx.fillStyle = d % 2 === 0 ? '#ffcc00' : '#ff6600';
        rwCtx.fill();
    }
    // Gold ring outlines
    rwCtx.beginPath();
    rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, darkRingR + darkBorderW / 2 + outerRingW / 2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    rwCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc00'; rwCtx.lineWidth = 1.5; rwCtx.stroke();
    rwCtx.beginPath();
    rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, darkRingR + darkBorderW / 2 - outerRingW / 2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    rwCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc00'; rwCtx.lineWidth = 1.5; rwCtx.stroke();

    // 1) Dark border ring
    rwCtx.beginPath();
    rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, darkRingR, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    rwCtx.strokeStyle = '#1a1a1a';
    rwCtx.lineWidth = darkBorderW;
    rwCtx.stroke();

    // 2) Segments
    SEGMENTS.forEach(function(seg, i) {
        var startAngle = i * SEG_ANGLE_RAD - Math.PI / 2;
        var endAngle = startAngle + SEG_ANGLE_RAD;
        var midAngle = startAngle + SEG_ANGLE_RAD / 2;

        rwCtx.beginPath();
        rwCtx.moveTo(cx, cy);
        rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, segR, startAngle, endAngle);
        rwCtx.closePath();

        if (seg.type === 'epic') {
            var grad = rwCtx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, segR * 0.3, cx, cy, segR);
            grad.addColorStop(0, lightenColor(seg.color, 20));
            grad.addColorStop(1, seg.color);
            rwCtx.fillStyle = grad;
        } else {
            rwCtx.fillStyle = i % 4 === 0 ? '#2a2a42' : i % 4 === 2 ? '#252540' : '#2d2d4e';
        }
        rwCtx.fill();
        rwCtx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.15)';
        rwCtx.lineWidth = 1;
        rwCtx.stroke();

        // Text
        rwCtx.save();
        rwCtx.translate(cx, cy);
        rwCtx.rotate(midAngle);

        if (seg.type === 'epic') {
            rwCtx.textAlign = 'right';
            rwCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            rwCtx.fillStyle = seg.textColor;
            rwCtx.font = 'bold 11px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
            rwCtx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
            rwCtx.shadowBlur = 4;

            if (label.length > 12) label = label.substring(0, 10) + '..';
            rwCtx.fillText(label, segR - 14, 0);
        } else {
            rwCtx.textAlign = 'center';
            rwCtx.textBaseline = 'middle';
            rwCtx.fillStyle = '#666';
            rwCtx.font = '9px Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif';
            rwCtx.shadowColor = 'transparent';
            rwCtx.shadowBlur = 0;
            rwCtx.fillText('10K', segR * 0.62, 0);
        }
        rwCtx.restore();
    });

    // 3) Gold dots at segment boundaries (in dark ring)
    for (var d = 0; d < NUM_SEGMENTS; d++) {
        var angle = d * SEG_ANGLE_RAD - Math.PI / 2;
        var dx = cx + Math.cos(angle) * darkRingR;
        var dy = cy + Math.sin(angle) * darkRingR;
        rwCtx.beginPath();
        rwCtx.arc(dx, dy, 3, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
        rwCtx.fillStyle = '#ffcc00';
        rwCtx.fill();
    }

    // 4) Inner gold ring (segments outer edge)
    rwCtx.beginPath();
    rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, segR, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    rwCtx.strokeStyle = '#ffcc00';
    rwCtx.lineWidth = 2;
    rwCtx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 204, 0, 0.3)';
    rwCtx.shadowBlur = 8;
    rwCtx.stroke();
    rwCtx.shadowBlur = 0;

    // 5) Inner shadow for depth
    var innerGrad = rwCtx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, segR * 0.25, cx, cy, segR);
    innerGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    innerGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.3)');
    rwCtx.beginPath();
    rwCtx.arc(cx, cy, segR, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
    rwCtx.fillStyle = innerGrad;
    rwCtx.fill();
}

function lightenColor(hex, percent) {
    var num = parseInt(hex.replace('#', ''), 16);
    var rv = Math.min(255, (num >> 16) + percent);
    var gv = Math.min(255, ((num >> 8) & 0x00FF) + percent);
    var bv = Math.min(255, (num & 0x0000FF) + percent);
    return 'rgb(' + rv + ',' + gv + ',' + bv + ')';
}

function playTickSounds(duration) {
    try {
        var audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        var ticksNeeded = Math.floor(duration / 80);
        for (var i = 0; i < ticksNeeded; i++) {
            (function(idx) {
                setTimeout(function() {
                    if (!isSpinning) return;
                    var osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                    var gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                    osc.frequency.value = 800 + Math.random() * 400;
                    osc.type = 'sine';
                    gain.gain.value = 0.04;
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
                    osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
                    osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.05);
                }, idx * (duration / ticksNeeded) * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5));
            })(i);
        }
    } catch (e) {
        // Audio not supported
    }
}

// CONFETTI (exact from roulette-test-v2.html)

var confettiAnimId = null;

function launchConfetti() {
    var cc = document.getElementById('confettiCanvas');
    cc.style.display = 'block';
    cc.width = window.innerWidth;
    cc.height = window.innerHeight;
    var cctx = cc.getContext('2d');

    var colors = ['#FFD700', '#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4', '#45B7D1', '#FFA07A', '#98D8C8', '#FF4444', '#FFCC00', '#FF8800'];
    var particles = [];

    for (var i = 0; i < 180; i++) {
        particles.push({
            x: cc.width / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200,
            y: cc.height / 2,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 16,
            vy: -Math.random() * 18 - 4,
            w: Math.random() * 10 + 4,
            h: Math.random() * 6 + 2,
            color: colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
            rot: Math.random() * 360,
            rotSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15,
            gravity: 0.25 + Math.random() * 0.15,
            opacity: 1,
        });
    }

    function animate() {
        cctx.clearRect(0, 0, cc.width, cc.height);
        var active = false;

        particles.forEach(function(p) {
            p.x += p.vx;
            p.vy += p.gravity;
            p.y += p.vy;
            p.rot += p.rotSpeed;
            p.vx *= 0.99;

            if (p.y > cc.height + 50) {
                p.opacity -= 0.05;
            }

            if (p.opacity <= 0) return;
            active = true;

            cctx.save();
            cctx.globalAlpha = p.opacity;
            cctx.translate(p.x, p.y);
            cctx.rotate(p.rot * Math.PI / 180);
            cctx.fillStyle = p.color;
            cctx.fillRect(-p.w / 2, -p.h / 2, p.w, p.h);
            cctx.restore();
        });

        if (active) {
            confettiAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        } else {
            cc.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    if (confettiAnimId) cancelAnimationFrame(confettiAnimId);
    animate();
}

function stopConfetti() {
    if (confettiAnimId) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(confettiAnimId);
        confettiAnimId = null;
    }
    var cc = document.getElementById('confettiCanvas');
    if (cc) cc.style.display = 'none';
}

var rouletteTargetTime = null;
var rouletteLocalTimer = null;

async function checkRouletteQualification() {
    var area = document.getElementById('rouletteStatusArea');
    var btn = document.getElementById('rouletteSpinBtn');
    if (!S.wallet) {
        area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-dim);padding:1rem 0">Connect wallet first</div>';
        btn.disabled = true;
        return;
    }
    area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--text-dim);padding:1rem 0">Checking qualification...</div>';
    try {
        var r = await api('/api/roulette/check', { wallet_address: S.wallet });
        if (r.ok) {
            if (r.spin_available) {
                clearInterval(rouletteLocalTimer);
                rouletteTargetTime = null;
                area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#4ade80;padding:0.5rem 0;font-weight:700">✅ Spin available!</div>';
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = '🎰 SPIN';
            } else if (r.qualified) {
                // Calculate exact target time from server data
                var daysRemaining = r.days_remaining || 0;
                rouletteTargetTime = Date.now() + (daysRemaining * 86400000);
                updateRouletteCountdown(area, btn);
                // Local countdown every 30 seconds
                clearInterval(rouletteLocalTimer);
                rouletteLocalTimer = setInterval(function() {
                    updateRouletteCountdown(area, btn);
                }, 30000);
            } else {
                clearInterval(rouletteLocalTimer);
                rouletteTargetTime = null;
                area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#ff6b6b;padding:0.5rem 0">Hold 69M REDFO to qualify</div>';
                btn.disabled = true;
                btn.textContent = '🔒 LOCKED';
            }
        } else {
            area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#ff6b6b;padding:0.5rem 0">' + (r.error || 'Error') + '</div>';
            btn.disabled = true;
        }
    } catch(e) {
        area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:#ff6b6b;padding:0.5rem 0">Connection error</div>';
        btn.disabled = true;
    }
}

function updateRouletteCountdown(area, btn) {
    if (!rouletteTargetTime) return;
    var remaining = rouletteTargetTime - Date.now();
    if (remaining <= 0) {
        clearInterval(rouletteLocalTimer);
        area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.8rem;color:#4ade80;padding:0.5rem 0;font-weight:700">✅ Spin available!</div>';
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = '🎰 SPIN';
        checkRouletteQualification(); // refresh from backend
        return;
    }
    var d = Math.ceil(remaining / 86400000);
    var h = Math.floor((remaining % 86400000) / 3600000);
    var m = Math.floor((remaining % 3600000) / 60000);
    var timeStr = d + 'd ' + String(h).padStart(2,'0') + 'h ' + String(m).padStart(2,'0') + 'm';
    area.innerHTML = '<div style="font-size:0.75rem;color:var(--gold);padding:0.5rem 0">Qualified! ' + timeStr + ' remaining</div>';
    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = '⏳ ' + d + 'D';
}

// DO SPIN (backend + exact spin math from roulette-test-v2.html)
// ============================================================
async function doRouletteSpin() {
    if (isSpinning || !S.wallet) return;
    isSpinning = true;
    var btn = document.getElementById('rouletteSpinBtn');
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
        var r = await api('/api/roulette/spin', { wallet_address: S.wallet });
        if (r.ok) {
            // Find segment for this prize
            var segIdx = 0;
            if (r.prize_tier === 'epic') {
                for (var i = 0; i < SEGMENTS.length; i++) {
                    if (SEGMENTS[i].id === r.prize_id) { segIdx = i; break; }
                }
            }
            // Use the EXACT spin math from the test file
            var isEpic = r.prize_tier === 'epic';
            var segCenter = segIdx * SEG_ANGLE_DEG + SEG_ANGLE_DEG / 2;
            var jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * SEG_ANGLE_DEG * 0.5;
            var desiredAngle = ((360 - segCenter - jitter) % 360 + 360) % 360;
            var normalizedCurrent = ((currentRotation % 360) + 360) % 360;
            var delta = ((desiredAngle - normalizedCurrent) % 360 + 360) % 360;
            var fullSpins = 5 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
            var totalRot = fullSpins * 360 + delta;
            currentRotation += totalRot;
            var duration = 4500 + Math.random() * 1500;
            var canvas = document.getElementById('rouletteCanvas');
            canvas.style.transition = 'transform ' + duration + 'ms cubic-bezier(0.15, 0.60, 0.12, 1.0)';
            canvas.style.transform = 'rotate(' + currentRotation + 'deg)';
            playTickSounds(duration);

            setTimeout(function() {
                isSpinning = false;
                btn.disabled = false;
                checkRouletteQualification();
                // Find prize in PRIZES array for result display
                var prizeIdx = 0;
                for (var p = 0; p < PRIZES.length; p++) {
                    if (PRIZES[p].id === r.prize_id) { prizeIdx = p; break; }
                }
                showResult(prizeIdx);
                if (isEpic) launchConfetti();
            }, duration + 300);
        } else {
            showToast(r.error || 'Spin failed');
            isSpinning = false;
            btn.disabled = false;
            checkRouletteQualification();
        }
    } catch(e) {
        showToast('Connection error');
        isSpinning = false;
        btn.disabled = false;
    }
}
